title: East Arterial Construction & Heavy Congestion
historical_problem: East approach carries 80 vehicles with East road closed. Severe queue backlog threatened to lock the intersection.
historical_solution: NS Corridor Priority (NS: 50s, EW: 16s). Flushing open North-South corridor minimized gridlock and reduced waiting time by ~63%.

title: Code-3 Ambulance Transit on North Approach
historical_problem: Emergency response vehicle active on North approach requiring uninterrupted right-of-way.
historical_solution: Emergency North-South Green Wave (NS: 55s, EW: 15s). Provided zero-delay preemption for the ambulance.

title: Evening Peak East-West Arterial Imbalance
historical_problem: Heavy commute volume on East-West axis (140 vehicles) while North-South was lightly loaded (30 vehicles).
historical_solution: EW Heavy Corridor Priority (NS: 20s, EW: 50s). Maximized discharge on major arterial, saving 18s average wait per car.

title: Balanced Rush Hour Four-Way Saturation
historical_problem: High balanced demand on all four approaches causing cycle queue accumulation on red signals.
historical_solution: Balanced Dynamic Timing (NS: 35s, EW: 35s). Balanced green splits maintained steady queue dissipation.

title: North Approach Water Pipeline Closure
historical_problem: North approach closed due to infrastructure work, detouring traffic to East-West corridor.
historical_solution: EW Corridor Priority (NS: 18s, EW: 50s). Favored open East-West flow to prevent detour bottlenecks.
